resources.string: An archive includes saved objects and photos, forms, project settings, offline underlays and pending edits. Unfinished forms have a separate recovery route below. Restore creates a separate copy whose edits require review before sending. Export the archive to keep it outside the app.
Please wait until the current operation or field mode finishes. Active track recording, walking and stakeout continue.
Cancelled. The original data is preserved.
Archive created and verified. Use Export file to save it outside the app.
Verify this archive and create a separate project copy? Pending edits in the copy stay blocked until reviewed. The current project remains selected.
“%1$s” is available in the project chooser. Review its pending edits before sending them to the server.

Unreadable and replaced checkpoints are preserved here. A retry requires the original project and layer and must not replace another unfinished form. Export remains available when automatic recovery is impossible.
Form checkpoint restored. Return to the map to continue it.
An unreadable checkpoint could not be quarantined. Its source is still preserved. Export it before another recovery attempt.
This archive belongs to another project, account or server. Select the matching project and account.
Not enough free space to finish. The original data is preserved.
Not enough free memory for this project. Close other apps and retry.
This checkpoint cannot be opened here. Select its original project and finish the current form, or export the original for recovery.
The operation could not be completed. Check the archive, access and available space. The original project and checkpoints are preserved.
